maddeler.e:
يعتكف (form VIII)
# يَعْتَكِفُ (yaʕtakifu) /jaʕ.ta.ki.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# يَعْتَكِفَ (yaʕtakifa) /jaʕ.ta.ki.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# يَعْتَكِفْ (yaʕtakif) /jaʕ.ta.kif/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
